title: Not a verdict from the stars—an invitation to understand each other
intro: Explore a particular pair, or see which signs and numbers may feel easier to match. The detailed result follows the rules of the selected systems.
name: Name—optional
nameHint: Only for the wording; names do not change scores.
privacy: Names and dates are not sent to a server. Calculation happens in your browser; a shared link replaces dates with derived signs and numbers.
honesty: The percentage shows how signs and numbers combine under this calculation. It is not the probability of a happy relationship, marriage, or divorce.
pairLead: {a} and {b}: the strongest match is “{strong}”; the area worth discussing most is “{attention}.” This is not a verdict—it is a conversation starter.
zodiacText: {signA} ({elementA}) + {signB} ({elementB}). This layer compares popular symbolic descriptions of pace and emotional style.
syutsaiText: Consciousness numbers: {conA} and {conB}; mission numbers: {missionA} and {missionB}. Consciousness carries 70% of the number layer, mission 30%.
attentionTitle: What is worth saying out loud
howRead: How to read 72%, 81%, and other numbers
howReadText: This scale belongs to our algorithm: 55% zodiac and 45% number layer. It helps compare areas but does not measure love, maturity, or a couple’s future.

strong.communication: It may be easier to put thoughts into words and return to a conversation after a misunderstanding.
strong.pace: A similar rhythm can reduce the feeling of being pushed or held back.
strong.closeness: There is a good symbolic reserve of warmth; support may be easier to notice and accept.
strong.daily: It may be easier to agree on order, time, and recurring everyday tasks.
strong.decisions: It may be easier to choose a direction and see who owns the next step.

attention.communication: Do not guess for the other person. Ask directly what they heard and what they need.
attention.pace: One may want speed while the other needs time. Agree on a decision deadline in advance.
attention.closeness: Your preferred distance may differ. Say what care looks like for each of you.
attention.daily: Do not expect daily life to organize itself. Assign three recurring tasks and review in a week.
attention.decisions: Split the choice into a reversible trial and an expensive irreversible step. This reduces the fight over one perfect answer.

soloLead: For {name}, we compared all 12 signs and 9 consciousness numbers. A higher place means a more similar symbolic rhythm—not a perfect person.
namesDontScore: A name is used only in the writing. Cyrillic or Latin spelling does not change the calculation.
researchIntro: There really is a lot of birth-date data. It still does not justify publishing a “divorce rate for every sign.”
voasText: An England and Wales census analysis found no special attraction between supposedly compatible signs. It tested partner choice, not the quality of every marriage.
swedenText: Swedish data from 1968–2001 found no consistently lower divorce risk among couples labelled astrologically compatible.
realTitle: What matters more in real life
realText: Relationship research links stability with how people handle stress and conflict, communicate, support each other, and navigate real-life conditions. These are associations, not guarantees.
researchLimit: The studies below examine broad statistics on birth dates and marriages, not the story of a particular couple. Our calculation follows Zodiac and Syutsai rules and offers an additional view of a relationship.
socialPrivacy: The counter receives only a calculation event. Names, dates, and results are not included.
supportText: Every result stays free. If it helped, buy the developer a coffee or share the app.
disclaimer: Each person decides how strongly this reading resonates and helps. Use it as an additional view, not the sole basis for deciding whether to start, continue, or end a relationship. Safety, respect, and real actions always matter.
